anchors.description: Width of the bed base across the foot face, measured between the bottom-left and bottom-right corners of the striped bed skirt at floor contact; standard US queen mattress width 1.52 m (full/double 1.37 m).
anchors.visible_evidence: The striped bed skirt runs the full width of the foot of the bed; both bottom corners where the skirt meets the carpet are clearly visible, unobstructed by the rug or nightstands.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Queen vs full/double size cannot be distinguished; quilt overhang and click placement add a few cm.

anchors.description: Front-face height of the dark three-drawer bedside chest left of the bed, from its front top edge down to the front bottom edge at floor contact; typical three-drawer nightstand 0.55-0.75 m tall.
anchors.visible_evidence: The chest left of the bed shows its top surface with a clock and cup, three drawer fronts, and the bottom front edge meeting the carpet; the front face is fully visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact model unknown; could be a taller chest of drawers (up to ~0.8 m); the bottom edge sits in shadow.
